question: What residual moisture did the NMP- and the water-processed NMC532 cathodes contain at 20 °C?
rendered: According to the document "Perspectives on the relationship between materials chemistry and roll-to-roll electrode manufacturing for high-energy lithium-ion batteries", the residual moisture in the NMP-processed NMC 532 cathode was 200 ppm at 20 °C, and in the water-based one it was 625 ppm at 20 °C.

prompt.system: You answer questions about one document, "Perspectives on the relationship between materials chemistry and roll-to-roll electrode manufacturing for high-energy lithium-ion batteries", using only what that document contains. It is below among 3 documents, condensed: page by page, the sentences that state a value (other sentences are left out), then its tables row by row and facts read from its figures. Answer briefly.
